content.value_statement: Marketing tasks lose consistency when product, audience, and positioning details are scattered. This skill creates a reusable context document and maintains focused revisions.
actual_capabilities: Checks canonical and legacy product marketing context file locations.
Drafts context from repository documentation and existing marketing materials.
Guides users through positioning, audience, messaging, proof, and goals sections.
Updates selected sections while preserving unchanged content.
Maintains document versions, ISO dates, and newest-first changelog entries.
Creates `.agents/product-marketing.md` for reuse by other marketing skills.
limitations: Cannot verify market claims, competitor details, customer quotes, or performance metrics without reliable source material.
Auto-drafts depend on the completeness and accuracy of repository content.
B2B personas do not apply to every product and may require adaptation or omission.
It creates context documentation and does not replace dedicated copywriting, research, or analytics workflows.

use_cases.title: Establish early positioning
use_cases.description: Create a first marketing context for an early-stage product while clearly marking unsupported or incomplete sections.

use_cases.title: Maintain shared messaging
use_cases.description: Update audience, positioning, objections, or proof while preserving approved content and recording each substantive revision.

use_cases.title: Onboard a new client
use_cases.description: Organize repository evidence and stakeholder answers into a consistent context document for future marketing work.

prompt_templates.title: Create context from scratch
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a product marketing context for [product]. Ask me one section at a time, confirm each answer, and skip sections that do not apply.

prompt_templates.title: Auto-draft from a repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Auto-draft our product marketing context from the repository. Cite the source files used, mark missing information, and present the draft before saving.

prompt_templates.title: Update audience and positioning
prompt_templates.prompt: Read our existing context document. Update [sections] using [new information], preserve all other content, then show the proposed revision for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused revision after a product or market change.

prompt_templates.title: Audit strategic context
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our context for contradictions, unsupported claims, weak differentiation, and missing proof. Propose prioritized changes, then update approved sections and record the revision.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before a major campaign.

output_examples.input: We sell feedback software to product teams and need a first context.
output_examples.output: A structured draft covering the product, audience, pain points, differentiation, objections, customer language, proof gaps, goals, and questions requiring confirmation.

output_examples.input: Our enterprise tier now targets engineering leaders. Update the existing context.
output_examples.output: A focused revision to the product overview, target audience, personas, objections, and competitive landscape, with unchanged sections preserved and documented.

output_examples.input: Draft our context from the repository.
output_examples.output: A source-informed context draft that distinguishes supported facts from missing information and requests review before saving the final document.

best_practices: Provide verified customer language and proof points instead of polished assumptions.
Review every auto-drafted claim and correct missing or outdated information before saving.
Update only affected sections and write a specific changelog reason for each substantive revision.
anti_patterns: Do not treat repository copy as verified customer or market research.
Do not force B2B persona sections onto consumer products when they do not apply.
Do not rewrite unchanged sections or remove prior changelog entries during focused updates.

faq.question: What file does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates `.agents/product-marketing.md` and can recognize supported legacy locations.

faq.question: Can it draft context from my repository?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews relevant documentation and marketing materials, marks gaps, and asks you to confirm the draft.

faq.question: Does it perform market research?
faq.answer: No. It organizes available evidence and user input but cannot independently validate markets, competitors, or customer claims.

faq.question: Can it update only one section?
faq.answer: Yes. It can revise selected sections while preserving the rest of the existing context.

faq.question: How are revisions tracked?
faq.answer: Substantive saves increment the document version, update the ISO date, and prepend a specific changelog entry.

faq.question: Does every product need every section?
faq.answer: No. Sections such as B2B personas can be adapted or omitted when they do not fit the product.
